text:
maya: Heads up — just got escalation from AcroMaps. Their month-end invoice is ~18% higher than what the dashboard shows for March. Customer says line items moved up a tier for the last 3 hours of the month and they were charged the higher per-token rate.

ingrid_billing: @maya can you paste the invoice line IDs and the dashboard export they sent? I'll start a delta check.

maya: attaching their export snippet (pasted):
```
invoice_line: inv_ln_9a2
period: 2026-03-01 - 2026-03-31
plan_tier: pro -> enterprise (prorated)
tokens_billed: 4,812,900
dashboard_tokens: 4,073,412
charge_diff: $1,420.50
```

maya: customer says they did not change plan, they have a reserved seat plan that should not auto-upgrade.

alex_sre: I can look at meter events around 2026-03-31 23:45-23:59 UTC. Possible causes: retry storms, duplicated meter writes during cutoff, or a race in tier calculation when usage crosses threshold.

jess_devex: Also check for any ingestion pipe lag — dashboard uses near-real-time aggregate while billing job uses finalized metering table — mismatch often caused by late-arriving token events or double-counted retries.

ingrid_billing: I pulled billing ledger rows for invoice inv_10345, lines: inv_ln_9a2, inv_ln_9b7. The meter shows a spike at 2026-03-31T23:51:12Z for customer_id: acct_77cc. meter_event_ids: [me_98a, me_98b, me_98c].

maya: Customer provided request IDs for slow endpoint calls around that time: req_3456abc, req_3456abd, req_3456abe. They say they saw 5xx errors then retried.

alex_sre: If retries were recorded as successful token usage by the billing metering job but deduped from the dashboard aggregator, that'll explain the delta. Can you share the raw meter events?

ingrid_billing: Paste of raw events (trimmed):
```
me_98a | acct_77cc | 2026-03-31T23:50:59Z | tokens: 42 | status: success | request_id: req_3456abc
me_98b | acct_77cc | 2026-03-31T23:51:05Z | tokens: 42 | status: retry | request_id: req_3456abc
me_98c | acct_77cc | 2026-03-31T23:51:12Z | tokens: 42 | status: success | request_id: req_3456abc
```

oliver_fin: Looks like the same request recorded thrice — two successes + a retry. Billing pipeline dedup key should be request_id + timestamp window; maybe the dedupe window shrank at month boundary due to partition swap.

alex_sre: I'll grep the metering worker logs around the partition rollover: `/var/log/metering/worker.log` entries show a partition flush at 2026-03-31T23:50:58Z and a resync job triggered at 23:51:04Z. Possible race: flush wrote me_98a, then resync re-ingested the queued retry and wrote me_98c without dedupe.

alex_sre: snippet from logs:
```
[23:50:58] INFO partition.flush partition=2026-03-31
[23:51:03] WARN ingestion.resync start partition=2026-03-31
[23:51:04] INFO meter.write id=me_98c request_id=req_3456abc tokens=42
```

jess_devex: Is dashboard aggregation using streaming dedupe or the post-flush consolidated table? If it reads consolidated, it may have deduped duplicates earlier.

ingrid_billing: Billing reads the finalized ledger table after partition finalize. If duplicates were inserted before finalize but not deduped, billing would count them. Dashboard streaming job applies an in-flight dedupe, so it may have suppressed the duplicate.

maya: Quick ask for customer reply: can we offer temporary credit if this was our ingestion bug? They already escalated to legal.

oliver_fin: If we confirm duplication on our side, credit is appropriate. Estimate duplicate tokens: looks like ~739,000 tokens (matches the ~$1.4k diff). Approve provisional credit pending confirm.

alex_sre: Action items: 1) I will run a dedupe check across ingestion partitions for acct_77cc for last 2 hours of month. 2) Run a job to compute unique token count by request_id for that window and compare to billing. 3) Add alert if partition flush/resync occur within 1m at month boundary.

ingrid_billing: I'll hold the invoice for AcroMaps (mark pending) and flag finance for review.

maya: Customer update message drafted: "We're investigating an ingestion issue that may have resulted in duplicate meter records during the month boundary. We're pausing invoicing while we validate and will follow up within 48 hours. Apologies for the disruption." Approve? :pray:

oliver_fin: Approve. Also note we should not auto-send reminder emails while invoice is pending.

jess_devex: Long-term: we should add a consistent dedupe middleware keyed on (customer_id, request_id) at ingestion layer and ensure the month-end finalize job also runs dedupe. Filing infra ticket INF-7923.

alex_sre: I ran the dedupe compare — preliminary numbers: billing_count = 4,812,900, unique_by_request_id = 4,073,450, duplicates = 739,450. Results match the customer's delta within rounding.

ingrid_billing: Confirmed. I will generate a credit memo for inv_10345 and mark line inv_ln_9a2 reversed for 739,450 tokens.

maya: I'll send the customer the credit + formal root-cause once we close postmortem.

recon_bot: incident created: INC-2026-041, severity: low-medium, owners: alex_sre, jess_devex.

alex_sre: Postmortem actions: tighten partition flush/resync sequencing, add dedupe pass in finalize, add a reingestion check to prevent double-writes during resync.

maya: Thanks everyone — keeping AcroMaps in the loop now.

oliver_fin: Note for audit: keep the duplicate event rows and logs for 90 days for compliance.

maya: Closing loop later with customer once credits applied.
